text: At its meeting held December 17 and 18, 2024, City Council considered item CA20.2 - Appointment of a Public Member to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee, and appointed the following member to the Housing Rights Advisory Committee for a term of office starting December 19, 2024 and ending on November 14, 2026: - Annie Hodgins This appointment fills the vacancy left by Danyaal Raza who resigned on September 23, 2024.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee received the item for information.
